title: Reducing the Effects of Climate Change

sentences.en: Mark Rowe reports on the increasingly ambitious geo-engineering projects being explored by scientists
sentences.zh: 马克·罗 (Mark Rowe) 报道了科学家们正在探索的日益雄心勃勃的地球工程项目

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: A. Such is our dependence on fossil fuels, and such is the volume of carbon dioxide already released into the atmosphere, that many experts agree that significant global warming is now inevitable.
sentences.zh: 答：由于我们对化石燃料的依赖,以及已经释放到大气中的二氧化碳量,许多专家一致认为,全球变暖现在是不可避免的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They believe that the best we can do is keep it at a reasonable level, and at present the only serious option for doing this is cutting back on our carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 他们认为,我们能做的最好的就是将其保持在合理的水平,而目前唯一认真的选择是减少我们的碳排放。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: But while a few countries are making major strides in this regard, the majority are having great difficulty even stemming the rate of increase, let alone reversing it.
sentences.zh: 但是,虽然少数国家在这方面取得了重大进展,但大多数国家甚至都很难阻止增长率,更不用说扭转它了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Consequently, an increasing number of scientists are beginning to explore the alternative of geo-engineeringa term which generally refers to the intentional large-scale manipulation of the environment.
sentences.zh: 因此,越来越多的科学家开始探索地球工程这一术语的替代品,该术语通常指对环境的有意大规模操纵。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: According to its proponents, geo-engineering is the equivalent of a backup generator: if Plan A - reducing our dependency on fossil fuels - fails, we require a Plan B, employing grand schemes to slow down or reverse the process of global warming.
sentences.zh: 根据其支持者的说法,地球工程相当于备用发电机：如果 A 计划（减少我们对化石燃料的依赖）失败,我们需要 B 计划,采用宏伟的计划来减缓或扭转全球变暖的过程。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: B. Geo-engineering has been shown to work, at least on a small localised scale.
sentences.zh: B. 地球工程已被证明是有效的,至少在小范围内是有效的。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For decades, May Day parades in Moscow have taken place under clear blue skies, aircraft having deposited dry ice, silver iodide and cement powder to disperse clouds.
sentences.zh: 几十年来,莫斯科的五一节游行一直在晴朗的蓝天下举行,飞机投放干冰、碘化银和水泥粉来驱散云层。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Many of the schemes now suggested look to do the opposite, and reduce the amount of sunlight reaching the planet.
sentences.zh: 现在许多计划建议采取相反的做法,减少到达地球的阳光量。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The most eye-catching idea of all is suggested by Professor Roger Angel of the University of Arizona.
sentences.zh: 其中最引人注目的想法是由亚利桑那大学的 Roger Angel 教授提出的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: His scheme would employ up to 16 trillion minute spacecraft, each weighing about one gram, to form a transparent, sunlight-refracting sunshade in an orbit 1.5 million km above the Earth.
sentences.zh: 他的计划将使用多达 16 万亿分钟的航天器,每个航天器重约一克,在距地球 150 万公里的轨道上形成一个透明的、可折射阳光的遮阳罩。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This could, argues Angel, reduce the amount of light reaching the Earth by two per cent.
sentences.zh: 安吉尔认为,这可以使到达地球的光量减少百分之二。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: C. The majority of geo-engineering projects so far carried out - which include planting forests in deserts and depositing iron in the ocean to stimulate the growth of algae - have focused on achieving a general cooling of the Earth.
sentences.zh: C. 迄今为止进行的大多数地球工程项目——包括在沙漠中种植森林和在海洋中沉积铁以刺激藻类生长——都集中于实现地球的全面冷却。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But some look specifically at reversing the melting at the poles, particularly the Arctic.
sentences.zh: 但有些人特别关注扭转两极的融化,特别是北极。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The reasoning is that if you replenish the ice sheets and frozen waters of the high latitudes, more light will be reflected back into space, so reducing the warming of the oceans and atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 原因是,如果补充高纬度地区的冰盖和冰冻水域,更多的光将被反射回太空,从而减少海洋和大气的变暖。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: D. The concept of releasing aerosol sprays into the stratosphere above the Arctic has been proposed by several scientists.
sentences.zh: D. 几位科学家提出了将气溶胶喷雾释放到北极上方平流层的概念。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This would involve using sulphur or hydrogen sulphide aerosols so that sulphur dioxide would form clouds, which would, in turn, lead to a global dimming.
sentences.zh: 这将涉及使用硫或硫化氢气溶胶,使二氧化硫形成云,进而导致全球变暗。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The idea is modelled on historic volcanic explosions, such as that Mount Pinatubo in the Philippines in 1991, which led to a short-term cooling of global temperatures by 0.5 °C.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是以历史上的火山爆发为蓝本的,例如 1991 年菲律宾皮纳图博火山的火山爆发,导致全球气温短期下降 0.5 °C。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Scientists have also scrutinised whether it's possible to preserve the ice sheets of Greenland with reinforced high-tension cables, preventing icebergs from moving into the sea.
sentences.zh: 科学家们还仔细研究了是否有可能用加固的高压电缆保护格陵兰岛的冰盖,防止冰山移入大海。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Meanwhile in the Russian Arctic, geo-engineering plans include the planting of millions of birch trees.
sentences.zh: 与此同时,在俄罗斯北极地区,地球工程计划包括种植数百万棵白桦树。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Whereas the region's native evergreen pines shade the snow-an absorb radiation, birches would shed their leaves in winter, thus enabling radiation to be reflected by the snow.
sentences.zh: 该地区的原生常绿松树可以遮挡雪并吸收辐射,而桦树会在冬天落叶,从而使辐射能够被雪反射。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Re-routing Russian rivers to increase cold water flow to ice-forming areas could also be used to slow down warming, say some climate scientists.
sentences.zh: 一些气候科学家表示,改变俄罗斯河流的路线以增加流向结冰地区的冷水也可以用来减缓变暖。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E. But will such schemes ever be implemented?
sentences.zh: E. 但是这样的计划会被实施吗？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Generally speaking, those who are most cautious about geo-engineering are the scientists involved in the research.
sentences.zh: 一般来说,对地球工程最持谨慎态度的是参与研究的科学家。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Angel says that his plan is 'no substitute for developing renewable energy: the only permanent solution'.
sentences.zh: 安吉尔表示,他的计划“不能替代开发可再生能源：唯一的永久解决方案”。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And Dr Phil Rasch of the US-based Pacific Northwest National Laboratory is equally guarded about the role of geo engineering: "I think all of us agree that if we were to end geo-engineering on a given day, then the planet would return to its pre-engineered condition very rapidly, and probably within ten to twenty years.
sentences.zh: 美国太平洋西北国家实验室的 Phil Rasch 博士对地球工程的作用同样持谨慎态度：“我认为我们所有人都同意,如果我们在某一天结束地球工程,那么地球将非常迅速地恢复到工程前的状态,而且可能在十到二十年内。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: That's certainly something to worry about.
sentences.zh: 这当然是值得担心的事情。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F. The US National Center for Atmospheric Research has already suggested that the proposal to inject sulphur into the atmosphere might affect rainfall patterns across the tropics and the Southern Ocean.
sentences.zh: F. 美国国家大气研究中心已经提出,向大气中注入硫的提议可能会影响热带地区和南大洋的降雨模式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Geo-engineering plans to inject stratospheric aerosols or to seed clouds would act to cool the planet, and act to increase the extent of sea ice, says Rasch.
sentences.zh: 地球工程计划注入平流层气溶胶或种子云将起到冷却地球的作用,并起到增加海冰范围的作用,拉什说。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But all the models suggest some impact on the distribution of precipitation.
sentences.zh: 但所有模型都表明对降水分布有一定影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: G. A further risk with geo-engineering projects is that you can "overshoot"," says Dr Dan Lunt, from the University of Bristol's School of Geophysical Sciences, who has studied the likely impacts of the sunshade and aerosol schemes on the climate.
sentences.zh: G. 地球工程项目的另一个风险是你可能会“过度”,”布里斯托大学地球物理科学学院的 Dan Lunt 博士说,他研究了遮阳和气溶胶方案对气候可能产生的影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: 'You may bring global temperatures back to pre-industrial levels, but the risk is that the poles will still be warmer than they should be and the tropics will be cooler than before industrialisation.
sentences.zh: '你可能会让全球气温回到工业化前的水平,但风险是两极仍然比工业化前更温暖,而热带地区将比工业化前更凉爽。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To avoid such a scenario, Lunt says Angel's project would have to operate at half strength; all of which reinforces his view that the best option is to avoid the need for geo-engineering altogether.
sentences.zh: 为了避免这种情况,Lunt 表示 Angel 的项目必须以一半的力量运行；所有这些都强化了他的观点,即最好的选择是完全避免对地球工程的需要。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: H. The main reason why geo-engineering is supported by many in the scientific community is that most researchers have little faith in the ability of politicians to agree - and then bring in - the necessary carbon cuts.
sentences.zh: H. 地球工程受到科学界许多人支持的主要原因是,大多数研究人员对政治家同意并实施必要的碳减排的能力缺乏信心。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Even leading conservation organisations see the value of investigating the potential of geo-engineering.
sentences.zh: 即使领先的保护组织也看到了研究地球工程潜力的价值。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: According to Dr Martin Sommerkorn, climate change advisor for the World Wildlife Fund's International Arctic Programme, 'Human-induced climate change has brought humanity to a position where we shouldn't exclude thinking thoroughly about this topic and its possibilities.
sentences.zh: 世界自然基金会国际北极计划气候变化顾问 Martin Sommerkorn 博士表示,“人类引起的气候变化已将人类带到了这样一个境地,我们不应该排除彻底思考这个话题及其可能性。
